title: Glitch Protocol: The City Without Shadows | ECHO//100 Episode 24
description: Kavi’s physical form dissolves as the city’s defensive grid identifies him as a foreign virus. Episode 24 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction narrative.

scenes.text: Kavi’s skin flashes violet as the protagonist falls through brick, leaving discarded clothes behind.
scenes.caption: Kavi phases through wall
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of a red hoodie and backpack falling onto a dark alley floor, Kavi's translucent glowing purple silhouette floating mid-air.

scenes.text: Kavi stands naked in the Central Power Hub, body flickering like a broken bulb.
scenes.caption: Inside the Power Hub
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi stands in a high-tech obsidian room filled with pulsing neon conduits, his skin shimmering with purple digital static.

scenes.text: Blue holographic tendrils whip from the floor, locking exits with lethal, glowing precision code.
scenes.caption: Mira's defense grid
scenes.image_prompt: Holographic blue geometric shapes form a cage around Kavi, glowing with the distinctive light of Mira's sub-routines.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, orange antenna spinning rapidly to calculate a path through the grid.
scenes.caption: Byte scans the perimeter
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a small white floating bot with a cyan face, scans a complex terminal while Kavi clutches his fading arm.

scenes.text: The city identifies Kavi as corruption, and Mira’s sub-routines delete all organic data now.
scenes.caption: System identifies corruption
scenes.image_prompt: A massive holographic interface displays Kavi's biometric scan with a red error warning blinking in bold symbols.

scenes.text: Kavi must channel Null-energy to overwrite the grid, risking total erasure of existence.
scenes.caption: The dangerous reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching into a swirling vortex of black and purple Null-energy, his eyes glowing with dangerous red intensity.

scenes.text: Power flows through Kavi’s veins, replacing marrow with cold, unyielding streams of binary code.
scenes.caption: Biology becoming code
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's skin turning into a translucent grid pattern, veins glowing with shifting digital light as he hacks the central core.

scenes.text: Kavi’s hand vanishes, replaced by a window showing the city’s forbidden architecture deep inside.
scenes.caption: The shocking revelation
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of Kavi’s transparent palm revealing a tiny, intricate 3D model of the City Without Shadows spinning inside his skin.
